description: Read the full content of a specific Qt documentation page, or a single member of it with 'symbol'. Use the filename shown in search results.

file.description: Documentation page filename from a search result (e.g. 'signalsandslots.html'), or a module-relative path (e.g. 'qtcore/qobject.html').

symbol.description: Optional: Return only one member's documentation instead of the whole page. A name (e.g. 'singleShot', 'anchors.fill', 'AlignmentFlag', 'onCompleted') returns every overload and any property of that name; an enum constant or property access function returns its enum or property. An anchor, shown as {#anchor} after each signature (e.g. 'singleShot-5'), returns that block only. An unknown name returns the page's member list.

version.description: Optional: Qt version to read from (e.g., '6.10.0'). Defaults to the latest installed version.

name: qt_documentation_read
